name: Calla Lily
description: A flower that grows near water sources. When cooked, the petals have a chunky texture, yet are sweet and a little bitter.
fullDescription: A flower that grows near water sources. When cooked, the petals have a chunky texture, yet are sweet and a little bitter. Modern medicine recognizes Calla Lily's antidotal properties, but its astringent flavor is repulsive to many people.
